text:
My partner is Israeli, and we have been in the gradual process for the past three years (we are not married). At our next appointment in August, I will finally become eligible for an A/5 visa. Once I receive my A/5, I will also be able to apply for Bituach Leumi.

I have a question regarding the minimum stay requirement of 183 days in Israel. Since I have already been living in Israel on a B/1 visa for just over three years, and my centre of life has been in Israel throughout this period, have I already met this requirement?

I also have an upcoming trip to South Africa in September and possibly another trip to Europe in December. Including these trips and all my previous travel this year, I will still have spent well under 90 days outside Israel during the year.

Will these trips have any impact on my Bituach Leumi application once I receive my A/5 visa?
